text:
maria: Quick async sync — status update for the continuous-batch + KV warmup work. TL;DR: kernel perf patch merged, KV warmup plan needs one more owner, and a tiny canary tweak.

aj: Thanks — re: owner, I can take KV warmup orchestration if nobody else volunteers.

maria: @aj that'd be great. Can you own the end-to-end bump (orchestration + rollout policy)? We'll need you to coordinate with SRE for the canary window.

satoshi: I can help with the kernel side — PR 4821 includes the attention kernel rewrite (reduced tail latency for step sizes > 1024). I measured p50/p95 on staging: 24ms / 140ms -> ~12% p95 improvement when batching enabled.

dina: Nice. Do we have a regression test for KV eviction under high prefix reuse? I want to avoid cache thrash during warmup.

satoshi: There's a small fuzzer test in the branch but not the full regression harness. Adding it now — pushing a follow-up commit.

maria: Ownership checklist:
- Kernel perf: @satoshi (in-flight)
- KV warmup orchestrator: @aj (claimed)
- Canary gating + SLO updates: @rohit (please confirm)
- QA prompt set for end-to-end eval: @dina

rohit: I can take the canary gating. Plan: 30m canary with 1% traffic, monitor p95, error rate, and memory growth for KV nodes. If p95 regresses > 5% or mem growth > 200MB over window, automatic rollback.

dina: I'll assemble the prompt set — focusing on short-chat and long-context prefix blends. Any specific latency SLAs to bake into CI?

maria: Use current SLO baseline: p95 < 200ms for hotpath routes. Also add a synthetic heavy-prefix test (seq_len ~ 4096) to catch kernel edge cases.

satoshi: For the kernel release, note a config toggle in runtime: `continuous_batch.enabled=true` and `kv_prefetch.mode=aggressive`. We'll gate toggle in canary.

maria: Sample rollout commands for the ops runbook (paste into infra channel when ready):
```
# enable canary for model x on pool-gamma
redwood rollout set --pool pool-gamma --model rwlm-v2 --percent 1 --tag canary-cont-batch
redwood config set --pool pool-gamma continuous_batch.enabled true
redwood config set --pool pool-gamma kv_prefetch.mode aggressive
```

aj: Heads up: SRE wants a warmup window before traffic spikes — will add a 5-min gradual ramp in the rollout plan.

rohit: Canary-bot reports: CPU on canary node +12% vs baseline but mem stable. Will keep an eye during the 30m. :eyes:

canary-bot: canary-cont-batch started for pool-gamma at 2155555600, 1% traffic. Monitoring p95, errors, mem.

maria: Two quick asks: 1) @aj please add healthcheck hook to abort if KV eviction rate > 50/s. 2) @dina ping me when eval set is uploaded.

aj: Will add the hook. Example metric to check: `kv.evictions.rate` from telemetry.

dina: Uploaded prompt set to /evals/cont_batch_kv_v1 and triggered nightly run. Linking PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rt-evals/pull/129 :thumbsup:

maria: Great. If all green, we plan to roll to 10% tomorrow and then full pool by EOW. If any spike, rollback to previous model variant and disable `continuous_batch` toggle.

deploy-bot: rollout succeeded to 1% at 2155555601. No errors in first 5 minutes.

rohit: After 25 minutes: p95 stable, error rate unchanged, mem +80MB. Proceeding to keep canary for remaining window.

maria: Perfect. I'll update the project board with owners and next milestones. Quick CR ping: @satoshi your kernel PR needs one more reviewer from eng-runtime to approve the racy buffer change. Can @dina or @aj take a look?

aj: I'll review this afternoon.

dina: I can take a look after tests finish (ETA ~2h).

maria: Thanks team — will recap in the weekly sync. If anything unexpected pops up, call the pager. :phone:
